properties.title: Flood Advisory issued July 23 at 3:30PM MDT until July 23 at 6:30PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
* WHAT...Arroyo and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...West Central Socorro County in central New Mexico...

* WHEN...Until 630 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 330 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause arroyo and small stream flooding.
Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Areas immediately south of Magdalena.
- http://www.weather.gov/abq/EmergencyPrepFlood
properties.instruction:
Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

In hilly or mountainous terrain there are numerous low water
crossings which are potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

Arroyos, streams, and normally dry rivers can become raging killer
currents in a matter of minutes. Water in arroyos can travel many
miles and take hours to reach your location from upstream rain areas.

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued July 23 at 2:17PM MST until July 23 at 3:45PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
At 217 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms produced heavy
rain over the Bright Angel Creek Basin below the Dragon Bravo Fire
scar. Between 0.5 and 1 inch of rain has fallen. Flooding impacts
will continue, but no additional rainfall is expected. Flash flooding
is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

flash flooding in and around the Bright Angel Creek Basin
below the Dragon Bravo Fire scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

Bright Angel Creek Basin below the Dragon Bravo Fire scar.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Phantom Ranch, North Rim Visitor Center, Point Imperial Picnic
Area, Saddle Mountain Overlook, Cape Royal Point, Bright Angel
Point and Vista Encantada.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 87 and 88...and
between river miles 99 and 100.

Ribbon Falls, Bright Angel Campground, North Rim Campground,
Cottonwood Campground, Clear Creek Camp Site, Upper Cremation Camp
Site, Lower Cremation Camp Site, Roy's Beach Camp Site, Boat Beach
Camp Site, Crystal Camp Site, Ego Beach Camp Site, Above Tuna Creek
Camp Site, Above Tuna Rapids Camp Site, Manzanita Rest Area and
Roaring Springs.

Zoroaster Canyon, Kwagunt Creek, Slate Creek, South Canyon, Lava
Canyon, North Canyon, Tuna Creek, Clear Creek, Nankoweap Canyon,
Shinumo Creek, Saddle Canyon, Colorado River, Unkar Creek, Bright
Angel Creek, Crystal Creek and Buck Farm Canyon.

hikers should get away from creeks and move to higher ground
immediately! Stay away or be swept away!

properties.description:

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Middle and South Aspen Acres Burn Scar in...
East Central Custer County in southeastern Colorado...
West Central Pueblo County in southeastern Colorado...

Beulah Water Intake.

extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches
in the Middle and South Aspen Acres Burn Scar. Severe debris flows
can also be anticipated across roads. Roads and driveways may be
washed away in places. If you encounter flood waters...climb to
safety.
